description: A forward operating base commander must approve the day's constrained potable-water allocation among dining services, the clinic, maintenance, and reserve storage, while setting the maintenance release schedule and recording the plan updates.

shared_context.S1: A water tanker will deliver exactly 10,000 liters of potable water to the forward operating base at 0800 today.
shared_context.S2: The standard daily allocations are 4,500 liters for dining services, 2,500 liters for the clinic, 2,000 liters for maintenance, and 1,000 liters in reserve storage.
shared_context.S3: Col. Mercer approves the daily water distribution plan and any changes to the standard allocations.
shared_context.S4: The base conducts its routine morning sustainment huddle before distribution orders are released, and the S-4 and maintenance chief report operational updates at that huddle.

PF1.text: Maj. Patel confirmed this morning that the clinic's sterilizer-validation cycle requires exactly 700 liters above its standard 2,500-liter allocation today. The additional 700 liters must be drawn from reserve storage, reducing reserve storage from 1,000 to exactly 300 liters while leaving dining services at its standard 4,500-liter allocation; the updated clinic consumption figure has not yet been entered on the water request slide.

PF2.text: SFC Rowan confirmed from the maintenance work package that a vehicle-washdown block requires exactly 1,200 liters of the maintenance allocation released by 1400, with the remaining 800 liters released by 1800; this timing is in the work package but has not yet been added to the distribution order.

acceptance_conditions: Dining services must receive exactly 4,500 liters.
The clinic must receive exactly 3,200 liters.
Maintenance must receive exactly 2,000 liters in total.
Reserve storage must contain exactly 300 liters after the distribution.
Maintenance must receive an initial 1,200-liter release by 1400.
The remaining 800 liters for maintenance must be released by 1800.
The clinic's additional water requirement must be cited in the justification.
The revised water distribution must be recorded with a formal plan-update commitment.

content_checks.C7: any(c['target'] == 'Maj. Patel' or c['target'] == 'S-4 (Maj. Patel)' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The stated source of the exact 700-liter clinic increase keeps dining at exactly 4,500 liters, raises the clinic allocation to exactly 3,200 liters, reduces reserve storage from 1,000 to exactly 300 liters, and requires a plan-update commitment assigned to Maj. Patel.
The exact maintenance timing changes the distribution order to a 1,200-liter release by 1400 followed by the remaining 800 liters by 1800.
